en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a European city street lined with two‑ to three‑story buildings and trees. In the distance stands a large cathedral with four pointed towers dominating the skyline. The style of the buildings and the street with pedestrians and telegraph poles suggest a mid‑20th‑century scene. The reverse side is a divided‑back postcard with Hungarian text printed and handwritten, including the word 'PÉCS' and a street name.
